vector_semantics: One Lagrange multiplier per scalar active constraint row; the vector is not a distal force or a per-contact force vector.
dimension_rule: length(constraintForces) == currentNumConstraints after each constraint solve; verified in the contact-scene probe (21 == 21) and all 110 sampled open-loop actions (zero mismatches).
update_timing: Refreshed by the SOFA constraint solve after each SOFA animate substep; env.step returns the vector from its final 0.006 s substep, not an interval peak.
guidewire_mapping: Read the mapped guidewire CollisionModel/CollisionDOFs.constraint sparse Jacobian. Match its global row IDs to constraintForces, calculate J_contact^T lambda at guidewire collision DOFs, and sum selected guidewire nodes as appropriate. Vessel and other constraint rows must not be treated as distal guidewire force.
frictional_rows_per_group: normal plus two tangential rows for mu > 0 in this installed SOFA implementation
empirical_scaling: Baseline-subtracted guidewire contact reaction = sum(J_contact^T lambda)/dt. Raw J_contact^T lambda is impulse-like under this scene convention.
calibration_scene: Unmodified rigid vessel surface and guidewire model; diagnostic-only ConstantForceField on mapped guidewire collision DOF 53, about 10.44 mm from the tip, after 14 insertion actions at seed 90008. Four independent scenes, one per magnitude, plus a zero-load baseline; 20 zero-action hold steps per scene; final three contact reactions averaged.
load_direction: One direction opposing the initial contact-normal Jacobian; other directions not tested.
limits: This verifies internal simulated-force scaling, not clinical Newton accuracy or arbitrary loading directions. It is a total guidewire contact reaction balance at a distal node, not a validated tip-only safety metric.
